**UnitedHealth Group** bought out Amedisys for $3.3 billion in an all-cash deal. Amedisys now operates as a wholly-owned subsidiary under UnitedHealth's health services division, **Optum**. [](https://www.fiercehealthcare.com/payers/unitedhealth-amedisys-sell-facilities-settlement-doj)

- **Price:** $101 per share ($3.3 billion total value)

- **Announcement Date:** June 26, 2023

- **Completion Date:** August 2025 (following an antitrust settlement with the U.S. Department of Justice) [](https://www.healthcaredive.com/news/unitedhealth-amedisys-deal-closes-doj/757742/)
